basic_info.description: Charming remodeled 3-bedroom, 2-bedroom single-family home in Bernal Heights. This sunny 1,744 sq ft residence features hardwood floors, recessed lighting, and a cozy fireplace in the living area. The chef's kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, stone countertops, and plenty of cabinet space. There are two options for a primary suite, one on the lower level and one on the upper level. The room on the lower level is incredibly spacious with access to the backyard it would be a great primary bedroom or den area for the family. Two bedrooms are located upstairs. Both bathrooms have modern updates. The attached two car garage is a rare commodity in San Francisco with space for two cars side-by-side and storage. The private backyard is full of potential. Located just steps from Cortland Ave with easy access to cafes, shops, parks and public transit. This home combines comfort, style and community in the heart of Bernal Heights.
